title: Scout camera quad
generationMode: built-in original generation; no reference image uploaded
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single modular top-down player body sprite for an original modern pixel-art territory-capture arcade game.
Output: square 1024 x 1024 PNG, genuinely transparent background with alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no ground shadow, no vignette, no floor. One isolated aircraft BODY ONLY centered in the image; nose points straight UP/north, strictly orthographic view, no perspective, no banking. Keep all solid geometry inside the central 80 percent of the canvas and preserve clean transparent margin.
Style: handsome modern pixel-art sprite with deliberate large crisp stepped clusters, a restrained 12-color look, simple broad readable lit panels and dark separating edges. Bright enough to read at 16 to 32 screen pixels. Rich original design through silhouette and mass, not tiny circuitry. No text, labels, logos, serial numbers, badges, actual brand marks, or Z markings. This is fictional Ukrainian player-craft art, not a real equipment model. Small restrained blue-and-yellow identification bands are allowed on the body, no insignia.
Modular requirement: draw the chassis, support arms and clearly visible circular MOTOR HUBS. Draw NO propeller blades, rotor discs, rotor blur or motion trails: the game separately animates three-blade rotors at the hub centers. Do not bake an action effect, shield, scan ray, cable, projectile, fire, smoke or explosion into the image. No extra detached components, no montage, no multiple views, no sheet borders.

Subject / distinguishing silhouette: A short rounded-rectangular pale ivory camera fuselage, visibly broad front shoulders and a bold dark camera eye at the NORTH nose. Four short arms form a wide H-like quad silhouette, with four round motor hubs near normalized canvas (0.25,0.27), (0.75,0.27), (0.25,0.73), (0.75,0.73). Steel-blue arms and bright ivory shell, one small yellow panel. The central camera pod should be a large readable feature, not miniature greebles. Symmetric left/right silhouette; clearly distinguish its front from rear.
Return only this single original sprite on real transparent alpha. Preserve hub centers and all edges; leave rotating blades for the separate rig.

Body and exposed hubs only; no propeller blades are baked into the source.
Real alpha is retained, including low-alpha fringes and mostly near-opaque body pixels.
